rationale: Preview, validation, locked CAS, original archives, journal, recovery and idempotency for both ledgers.
Separate project-owned process records, generated index, commit/source/output-bound successful evidence, honest effectiveness claims.
Keep ESX frozen start/done timestamp; require exact iteration identity for new state and archive previous done records.
Content-bound successful start receipt before retained dispatch, final science and new-state closeout; legacy explicitly identified.
Exclude administrative records from expensive fingerprints; validate live ledgers even on cached passes; science configuration overrides exclusion.
ESX has no ADX verify_manifest parser. Preserve arbitrary configured input bytes, including comments; do not assume a language-independent comment semantics.
Generate role briefs from the existing report form; validate nested types, exact identities, own orientation and real approval evidence before completion.
Require the full configured structural suite for current state before Richard or review readiness; reuse exact current evidence.
Accept explicit empty constraints, emit stable handoffs, prepare unaccepted closeout from explicit metadata and actual verification.
Keep executable witnesses and normative instructions in inventory; register scientific witnesses and executable dependencies in project configuration.
Owner-recorded hashed CAS extension retains cumulative spend, unknown reservations, calls and history; cannot extend independent run cap.
Coordinator/child/repair/provider totals, interval unions, timed phases, native unknowns, missing timing and billing coverage.
Twice in three records schedules owning process work or one-closeout deferral; no new unrelated work until disposition.
Print standing/recent rules; flag repeats; reject repeated standing rules in new reflections; 25-rule budget and explicit retirement guidance.
All completed/partial/blocked closeouts create mandatory measured debt; problems need dispositions and open owners for deferral.
Archive accepted reflection plus accounting outside ignored loop_state; upgrades preserve project history.
ESX does not reject files_touched prose by path equality; exact identity and actual source/evidence remain authoritative.
Shared run/issue/turn limits, 80% handoff, isolated timeouts, early reports and deterministic reuse; no reduced scientific review.
Project-owned executable hook qualification and isolated optional installed-plugin checks.
ESX has its own canonical persisted prompt; Copilot-specific launcher details do not transfer.
ESX supports the project-owned Claude loop. Do not import a different host continuation guard. Alternate-host qualification remains separate.
Copilot-specific ADX host integration is outside ESX current support. Shared low-level adapter code is not evidence of an ESX Copilot deployment.
Paths resolve from deployment root, including spaces and invocation outside it; deployed template has no source-project dependency.
Each ESX project owns its hooks/state; external Ralph overlap is refused without changing global plugin settings.
Install SIGINT as well as SIGTERM/SIGHUP handling while owning execution, then restore inherited handlers.
New generated process index is administrative and stable; ESX has no ADX scientific precedent index.
Lesson validation uses the explicit ESX project root, never the Git root parent.
Generated process index has no volatile generation timestamp; ADX precedent-specific tool is absent.
All specialist instructions name the actual correction_round; retained runtime checks it.
Environment settings are normalized and tests control relevant overrides; secrets remain hashed in contract diagnostics.
Bounded owned loop retains terminal reasons and corruption archives; now also persists retrospective debt.
Verification fingerprints bind framework, configured source/tests/config, commands, external inputs, toolchain and environment; current acceptance is separately validated.
Skills occupy direct discoverable project skill directories; required files are checked.
Versioned project hooks and integrity checks are installed from the master while preserving unrelated settings.
ESX has no ADX-specific lesson-count limit to raise. Retain duplicate/evidence validation and project-owned lesson history.
Durable evidence is in devel-loop/loop_state; only hook-owned continuation state remains under .claude and is excluded from signatures.
Configured output exclusions and cache/state exclusions preserve untracked real source and witnesses. No blanket tracked-only filter.
